rationale: Lactate and arabinose fermentation with amino acid scavenging. Lactate is the preferred substrate; arabinose provides supplementary carbohydrate. Arginine and cysteine supply nitrogen and additional carbon. Mixed-acid fermentation products (acetate, propionate, CO₂, formate) are released. Growth rate of 0.50 /h is supported by C and N availability and is intermediate between observed turns 4 and 5.
